source.title: CelesTrak GP element set of ISS (ZARYA) (NORAD catalog number 25544)
source.note: Computed by this app from the orbit elements of the source, with a short form of the SGP4 model (a Kepler ellipse with the J2, J3 and J4 effects of the shape of the Earth and the drag rate of the element set). With the same elements, the result was within 2 km of an independent SGP4 service. The elements are a forecast: some days after their time, the true place of the station can be some tens of km away along the track.
